meta.title: Wander Peak — Treks and adventures in the mountains of Morocco
meta.description: Wander Peak organises treks and adventures in the mountains of Morocco: Imsfrane, Toubkal, M'Goun. No experience needed, everything organised, departures from Casablanca and Rabat.
meta.ogAlt: Hikers walking in single file up a snowy mountain slope

hero.title: We take you to the peaks.
hero.lead: A travel agency organising treks and adventures in the mountains of Morocco.

manifesto.title: The summit is better together.
manifesto.p1: Wander Peak is a Moroccan brand of travel, adventure and outdoor experiences.
manifesto.p2: Discover Morocco differently, break the routine, reconnect with nature and live authentic moments.
manifesto.passion: Most of all, we share the same passion.

universes.title: Choose your universe.
universes.lead: Every experience belongs to a universe. Pick the one that matches your mood.

experiences.title: Where we take you.
experiences.lead: From 800 to 1,800 MAD per person (indicative prices).

imsfrane.name: Imsfrane
imsfrane.summary: Two ways to experience Imsfrane, and a night in a tent.
options: A walk through the gorges and a trip to the cool, even icy, waterfalls: perfect for a summer swim.

toubkal.name: Toubkal
toubkal.summary: The highest peak in North Africa, climbed step by step with guidance designed for beginners.

mgoun.name: M'Goun
mgoun.summary: A High Atlas summit above 4,000 m, over three days of walking and two nights in tents.

promises.title: You walk, we handle the rest.

items.title: No experience needed
items.text: First trek or not, you're welcome.

items.title: Everything organised
items.text: Departure from Casablanca or Rabat: we take care of the organisation.

items.title: Choose
items.text: An experience, a date and the number of people.

items.title: Send
items.text: Your request opens in WhatsApp, ready to send.

gear.title: No gear? No problem.
gear.lead: Rent it with your trek, tents included.

items.a: No, no experience is needed. Toubkal, for example, is climbed step by step with guidance designed for beginners.
Departures are from Casablanca and Rabat.
From 800 MAD (Imsfrane) to 1,800 MAD (M'Goun) per person. Each experience shows its price. These prices are indicative and may change.

items.q: I don't have any gear, what can I do?
items.a: You can rent a tent, sleeping bag, mat, backpack, poles and headlamp with your trek, from 20 MAD per day.
Fill in the booking form: your request opens in WhatsApp, ready to send.

booking.modalLead: You haven't added any gear. Need something? Tick it here and we'll have it ready with your trek.

final.text: Most of all, we share the same passion.
